newsitem.title: USA: Life Industries appoints Baker president.
newsitem.headline: Life Industries appoints Baker president.

text.p: Life Industries Inc said on Thursday that it had appointed Marc Baker as the company's new president.

Baker, 37, assumes the post during the final stages of the company's restructuring and will also assist the board of directors in its search for a business acquisition, Life Industries said in a statement.
Previously, Baker worked as a staff accountant for Arthur Young International, as a controller for a clothing manufacturer and as a staff accountant for a regional CPA firm.
